purpose: Independent exact testcase identity reconciliation after the approved class/package migration
verificationScope: 0005 local Spring layering verification only; does not certify complete Java RAG, real provider retrieval quality, multimodal acceptance, staging, or production deployment.
matchingRule: For every frozen baseline {className,name}, map className by the explicit classMapping and require one exact current testcase name with passed status. Only the six approved simple-class renames are allowed; all other entries preserve the simple class name while permitting package migration. Duplicate identities and many-to-one matches are rejected.
limitations: Identity retention and report status do not independently prove assertion equivalence; behavior-test review and the source manifest remain separate evidence.
This evidence is local and does not authorize a production-complete claim.
